action_summary: Replace logit pooling with an equal-weight arithmetic mixture of normalized probabilities across all four TTA views and all five fold checkpoints. Preserve the binary-checkpoint interpretation using softmax(logsigmoid(logits)), mathematically equivalent to normalized sigmoid, with float32 probability calculations for stability. This targets forward-KL sensitivity to confidently wrong ensemble members while retaining the exact checkpoints, preprocessing, TTA, Kaggle paths and submission schema. Cache per-fold test probabilities for reuse and add finite-output checking; no training, inference, calibration fitting or leaderboard improvement is claimed without data.
